title: LA Colossal – Black Najeon 06 (Seated)
prompt:

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly resting in multiple deep overlapping rolls over the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips spreading across the bench, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body najeon-chilgi body painting from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, not latex. Deep glossy black lacquer inlaid with iridescent mother-of-pearl butterflies, peonies, and scattered stars. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Seated on a low black bench, leaning back slightly with both hands planted behind her, chest open and belly relaxed forward, legs crossed at the knee. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Nails: Extra long almond nails, pastel pearl.

Background & Lighting: Night garden with paper lanterns and a stone path, softly blurred. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm lantern light with raking side light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
